This can cause premature infra death in long runs. However... hmm, let me reconsider the likelihood once more. For infra to reach 8 without ANY successful step in between, you'd need capability-error steps interleaved between all 8 infra failures. Each capability-error step increments consecutive_failures → after 5 capability failures (with infra in between not resetting it!) the run dies at max_failures anyway. So to reach infra=8 you need ≤4 capability errors interleaved. E.g., infra, infra, cap, infra, infra, cap, infra, infra, cap, infra, infra, cap, infra → infra=8, cap=4 — dies by infra at 8th.
